title: Release flags
intro: Features that ship dark are switched on per deployment by LumiBase (a signed manifest) or by the operator, then per site by a site admin. A site can never switch on a feature that is not released.
memberIntro: Released features and whether they are on for this site. Ask a site admin to change them.
error: Could not load the release flags.
gateClosed: Not released on this deployment, so it cannot be turned on for a site.
forbidden: Only site admins can change release flags.
